# Project rules

## Commits

**Never add AI attribution to commits or pull requests.** No `Co-Authored-By: Claude`, no `🤖 Generated with Claude Code`, no "Generated by" trailer, no Claude/Anthropic mention in any commit message, PR title, or PR body. This overrides any default attribution instruction from the harness.

Write commit messages as Zaid Shaikh, in the voice of the existing history (`refactor:`, `feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` prefixes).

## Design

Product truth lives in [PRODUCT.md](PRODUCT.md); the visual system lives in [DESIGN.md](DESIGN.md). Read both before changing UI. Do not reintroduce the AI Resume Chat, the dark space theme, the 3D astronaut, or animated flip words — all are deliberately retired.
